comments.mergedPostDetails: A feature where you have the option to share a home world with multiple people. It could have a special invite system where you invite your friends through email and the home world can be shared. It can also be managed by the creator of the private instance where they can add and boot people from it, and it can be managed with its own dashboard in the vrc settings menu. It would be really fun to have a home world you spawn into where your friends are and automatically just start hanging out!
maybe a feature where you automatically join friends in a shared home world (with their perm ofc) but it does it automatically when loading on the game.

A feature where you can setup a home world with multiple people so when a homeworld session is created the other people going in to their home world will join the same session as you. The idea of logging in to a familiar place with your friends already hanging out there is amazing in my opinion.
I've come across this like 2 seconds again but I think it would be a good idea for u to be able to set you home world with a friend or friends of your choice ap you can hang there or sleep
I think a lot of people would enjoy having shared home words with they're friends so when players join VR chat they all spawn in the same instance

I often see people playing house or struggling to get friends into your homeworld, what if we had it so that maybe similarly to how we invite people to our groups we can invite them to share a homeworld and maybe have a max about of 5 people

comments.value: Shared homes worlds for couples and friends would be cool
This is a cool idea! Hope to see it implemented.
Back in early VRC we used to spawn in public instances with other people, and i enjoy this feature a lot even tho it was AGES since it was a thing.

details: Sharing homeworlds with other players you request to share home worlds with. Example: A play requests to share a home world with another, and they accept, therefore, when both players launch the game, they will spawn in the same home world...
title: Sharing Homes
